page_title: NAN 1-0 NIC | Nantes v Nice 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Ruddy Buquet has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Nantes quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
90+7' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Nantes.
90+6' Dante (Nice) commits a rough foul. Ruddy Buquet stops the game and makes a call.
90+4' That will be all from Pedro Chirivella who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lamine Diack (Nantes).
90+4' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) was too forceful with his tackle and Ruddy Buquet interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+2' The players claim that Gaetan Laborde (Nice) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Pedro Chirivella (Nantes). Ruddy Buquet doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
86' Moses Simon (Nantes) pounces on the rebound inside the penalty box and fires a promising shot, but he's only able to hit the right post!
86' Florent Mollet (Nantes) swings in a cross from a free kick, but Marcin Bulka collects calmly.
86' Ruddy Buquet has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice). Nantes have been awarded a free kick.
82' The substitution has been made. Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) has replaced Marcus Coco.
82' Substitution. Mostafa Mohamed will be replaced by Kader Bamba (Nantes).
81' The substitution is prepared. Jordan Lotomba (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Youssouf Ndayishimiye.
81' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Morgan Sanson will be replaced by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice).
78' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
78' Moses Simon (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
77' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
76' Jocelyn Gourvennec has decided to substitute Moussa Sissoko and he is replaced by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes).
72' Flag goes up against Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) is coming onto the pitch as Pablo Rosario cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.

69' That didn't go as planned! Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the roof of the net was too weak to get past Marcin Bulka, who easily kept it out.
69' Florent Mollet (Nantes) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
66' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and signals a foul after Pablo Rosario (Nice) brought his opponent down.
64' Khephren Thuram (Nice) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom of the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
64' The ball is crossed into the box and Terem Moffi (Nice) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Alban Lafont gets a glove on it to thwart him.
63' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the crossbar.
62' Here is a change. Jeremie Boga is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
62' It will be a substitution. Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is ready to enter the pitch as Evann Guessand walks off.
62' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and it's Evann Guessand (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
61' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) was quite harsh and Ruddy Buquet didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Pablo Rosario (Nice) heads on.
58' Morgan Sanson (Nice) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Terem Moffi (Nice) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
52' The corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is cleared away by the defence.

51' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

49' Florent Mollet (Nantes) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
49' Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul after Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Nantes get a free kick.
48' Terem Moffi (Nice) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
46' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
45+4' Florent Mollet (Nantes) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

45+2' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Marcin Bulka and the score remains the same.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) commits a rough challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul.
44' Terem Moffi (Nice) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header to the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
44' Morgan Sanson (Nice) steps up to send the ball in.
44' Morgan Sanson (Nice) takes the corner which is cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Nice.

43' Evann Guessand (Nice) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Alban Lafont is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.
42' Foul! Terem Moffi (Nice) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
39' The game is interrupted as Moses Simon (Nantes) is flagged offside.
38' The foul by Morgan Sanson (Nice) was seen by Ruddy Buquet who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' Terem Moffi (Nice) is caught offside!
35' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Looks like Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
31' Terem Moffi passes to Morgan Sanson (Nice), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
31' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ruddy Buquet has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' Moses Simon (Nantes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

28' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ruddy Buquet with no other option than to blow for a foul.
28' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
28' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Now Nantes have a corner.
25' 1 - 0 The goalkeeper makes a superb save, but the ball rebounds off him out to Florent Mollet (Nantes), who fires the ball into the roof of the net.
25' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Marcin Bulka anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
24' Khephren Thuram (Nice) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
24' Morgan Sanson (Nice) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
23' The referee blows his whistle as Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) was too aggressive in his challenge. Nice earn a free kick.
23' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul.
22' Marcus Coco (Nantes) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
19' Referee Ruddy Buquet sees the trip by Morgan Sanson (Nice) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
18' Jeremie Boga (Nice) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' The free kick is taken by Melvin Bard (Nice), but ball is cleared.
18' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ruddy Buquet had an easy-decision to make.
17' Moses Simon (Nantes) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
17' Florent Mollet (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
15' Ruddy Buquet interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes).
14' Melvin Bard (Nice) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
12' Terem Moffi (Nice) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
11' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

10' The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save as he denies the first-time effort by Khephren Thuram (Nice) from the edge of the box. The ball is out of play. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' Nice have a corner.
9' Dante (Nice) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
8' There's an opportunity for Morgan Sanson (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
8' Evann Guessand (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
6' Dante (Nice) is flagged for offside.
5' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
5' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Good work from Nantes as they win a corner.
4' Jeremie Boga (Nice) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
3' Jeremie Boga (Nice) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Nice will take a corner kick.
3' Nice hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet will supervise the game today.
